# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are provided for the latest stable LumeTrace release.

| Version | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| Latest stable release | Yes |
| Older releases | No |
| `develop` and other development builds | No |

Before reporting a vulnerability, confirm that it is reproducible with the latest stable release.

## Report a vulnerability

Do not open a public GitHub issue for a vulnerability that could put users, files, credentials, or devices at risk.

Submit the report privately through [GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/gurudin/lumetrace/security/advisories/new). If that form is unavailable, contact the maintainer through the [LumeTrace Discord community](https://discord.gg/6pJVMTJ5UG) and request a private reporting channel. Do not post vulnerability details in a public Discord channel.

Include:

- the affected LumeTrace version and macOS version;
- a clear description of the vulnerability and its impact;
- the minimum steps needed to reproduce it;
- a proof of concept, screenshots, or logs when safe to share;
- any known workaround or mitigation.

Remove API keys, passwords, private file contents, personal information, and other secrets before sending a report.

We aim to acknowledge complete reports within five business days. Fix and disclosure timing depends on severity, reproducibility, and release risk. Please allow time for investigation and a coordinated release before publishing details.

For ordinary bugs and feature requests that do not create a security risk, use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/gurudin/lumetrace/issues).
